name: decide
description: A second opinion for Claude from decide: it checks shell commands before they run, content from outside before Claude acts on it, and each reply against what the turn's tools showed, and gives Claude a judge tool for typed questions.

commands.title: Risky commands
commands.description: What happens when decide judges a shell command likely to destroy work or expose secrets. "ask" (the default): you choose, even in a mode that would run it without asking. "deny": it does not run, and Claude is told why. "off": commands are not checked.

decidePath.title: decide command
decidePath.description: The decide executable to run. Install it with: brew install deepnoodle-ai/tap/decide
